## Use this when

- help me find funding for my business
- which lenders or programs fit my business
- build a lender ready deck
- review my funding pitch
- help me prepare for SBA financing
- find capital options for this project
- turn my business info into a funding deck
- what am I missing before I seek funding

## Problem

A founder, operator or project owner needs bounded capital-path research, readiness gaps and evidence-led deck direction without fake approval odds or invented financing terms.

## Inputs

Company/project name, contact email and use of funds. Optional capital goal, website, business summary, existing pitch, revenue/profit/collateral context and timeline.

## Outputs

Research summary, capital-readiness notes, 3-6 public-source provider/program candidates, requirements and evidence links, recommended audience and a 6-14 slide deck outline.

## Pricing

$49 one-time for the Founding Capital Fit Sprint, limited to the first 20 paid cases. The $49 is credited toward a later Capital Package upgrade.

- Founding Capital Fit Sprint: $49 (one_time)
